Customer Service Manager Job at Enugu Air Limited




        
    

        
        Enugu Air Limited is recruiting personnel to serve as Purser on the Embraer 170. The candidate should be customer-centric, be a team player and have a great personality. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and customer focused Customer Service Manager to lead and manage customer service activities across our airport operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the consistent delivery of excellent customer service throughout the passenger journey while managing service standards, resolving customer concerns, and driving continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and supervise the customer service team to deliver excellent passenger experience.
	Develop, implement, and monitor customer service standards, procedures, and initiatives.
	Ensure passengers receive timely, professional, and accurate assistance across all customer touchpoints.
	Handle and resolve escalated customer complaints, service failures, and complex passenger issues.
	Monitor passenger service delivery during normal and disrupted operations.
	Coordinate with Passenger Services, Ground Operations, Cabin Services, Commercial, and other relevant departments to resolve customer issues.
	Develop strategies to improve customer satisfaction, service quality, and passenger experience.
	Monitor customer feedback and complaints and prepare reports identifying trends and improvement opportunities. 
	Ensure compliance with company policies, applicable aviation regulations, and passenger rights requirements.
	Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to improve the overall customer journey.
	Perform any other duties assigned by management. 


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor's Degree or HND
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in customer service, airline operations, hospitality, or a related service environment.
	At least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
	Previous experience in an airline, airport, or aviation environment is highly desirable.
	Experience managing customer complaints and service recovery processes is required.
	Relevant professional qualifications in customer experience or service management will be an added advantage. 
	NYSC: Evidence of completion or exemption from the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) scheme .

title: Job Openings at Corona Schools Trust Council
content:
Corona Schools Trust Council - The focus of the Corona Schools' Trust Council is the development of world-class schools.  World class in all facets of our operations - curriculum, teaching methodologies, staff quality, libraries, technology, buildings, resources, facilities, management and so on. In order to sustain our  mission to deliver world- class education to children inculcate high moral and ethical values as we prepare them for a life of service and fulfilment, we have embarked on a number of school improvement initiatives in recent years.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Business Development Manager

Job Location: Lagos
     

            
    



Role Summary


	The Business Development Manager is responsible for identifying, developing, and growing sustainable commercial opportunities across the school’s enterprise portfolio.
	The role oversees business growth initiatives, retail operations, financial performance, partnerships, and team leadership to ensure profitability, efficiency, and alignment with the school’s mission and values.


Key Responsibilities
Business Growth & Development:


	Develop and implement annual business plans for the school’s enterprise unit.
	Identify new income-generating opportunities within the school community.
	Introduce new products and services based on parents’ and students’ needs.


Retail & Operational Oversight:


	Oversee daily retail operations (uniforms, books, supplies, etc.).
	Ensure effective inventory management and prevent stock losses or shortages.
	Supervise retail systems, stock records, and sales reporting.
	Coordinate suppliers and logistics to ensure efficient service delivery.


Financial Management:


	Approve pricing recommendations in line with approval processes.
	Prepare budgets, forecasts, and expenditure plans.


Market, Partnerships & Relationships:


	Build and maintain strong relationships with parents, vendors, and service providers.
	Promote entpereneurial and retail services and identify business initiatives and cross-selling opportunities.


People Management & Governance:


	Supervise Business Officer, Retail/Enterprise Officer, and Logistics Officer.
	Set performance targets and provide coaching to improve productivity and service quality.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of email.

 

2.) Accountant

Job Locations: Lagos and Ogun

School Fees Function


	Prepare School Bills for All Students 
	Update Students’ Records 
	Prepare Billing Summary 
	Receive bank tellers and raise receipt via the cash receipt journal 
	Update cash receipt journal 
	Prepare a report of fees and extract the outstanding fees 
	Prepare termly school fees reconciliation 
	Students’ Population Statistics 
	Prepares weekly report of students’ population 
	Update students’ class list Treasury Function 
	Petty cash reimbursement function. 
	Bank imprest reimbursement function Duties and Responsibilities 
	Bank reconciliation function 
	Prepare of cash flow statement. 
	Maintenance of School Bank Account and supporting ledgers 


Others:


	Involved in the school day-to-day running expense decisions 
	Work with the Head of School to prepare the budget
	 Prepare the school’s financial statements. 
	Maintain Fixed Assets register 
	 Other tasks as assigned by the Financial Controller and the Head of School.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] , [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of email.

 

 

3.) Customer Experience Representative

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary 


	We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused, and results-driven Customer Experience Representative to support student enrolment, parent engagement, and overall customer satisfaction within our school community.


Key Responsibilities
Admissions & Customer Engagement:


	Serve as the first point of contact for prospective families, providing excellent customer experience
	Manage enquiries and follow up with prospective parents via calls, emails, and other channels
	Coordinate and conduct school tours for prospective parents
	Support and implement the school’s admissions process, including application review and processing


Sales & Enrolment Growth:


	Drive enrolment conversion by meeting and exceeding set targets
	Apply a consultative approach to understand family needs and guide decision-making
	Manage leads from initial enquiry to enrolment using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Sales Cloud)
	Track and report on key performance metrics (calls, conversions, pipeline growth)
	Handle objections effectively and propose suitable solutions to close enrolment


Marketing & Brand Support:


	Support management of the school’s social media platforms in collaboration with the marketing team
	Contribute ideas and feedback to improve enrolment strategies and customer engagement.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field
	Experience in customer service, sales, admissions, or a related role
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills
	Ability to meet targets and work with data-driven metrics
	Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Office
	Professional, personable, and customer-focused approach.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] , [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of email.

title: Job Openings at Akenn Travel and Tours
content:
At Akenn, we believe great travel experiences start with great people. We give our team room to take ownership, grow their skills and make a meaningful impact while building the future of travel.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Digital Marketing & Content Executive

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview
     

            
    




	Help Akenn turn its travel expertise, destinations and experiences into content, campaigns and measurable business opportunities.
	This isn’t simply a social-media posting role; we’re looking for someone who understands content, digital marketing, audience behaviour and lead generation.


What you’ll do


	Plan and execute content across Akenn’s key digital channels, in line with business and campaign objectives.
	Plan and maintain the content calendar in line with business and campaign objectives.
	Create compelling copy, content concepts and campaign ideas for travel audiences.
	Coordinate the production of social media, website, email and promotional content.
	Run effective paid digital campaigns and monitor performance against agreed objectives.
	Track meaningful metrics including reach, engagement, enquiries and leads, and use the data to improve campaigns.
	Research travel trends, target audiences, competitors and content opportunities.
	Develop campaigns that support specific business objectives, including lead generation and promotion of travel products.
	Maintain consistency in Akenn’s brand voice, positioning and visual direction.
	Work closely with the Sales and Travel teams to understand customer insights and translate them into better marketing.
	Test new content and digital approaches and make practical recommendations based on results.


Requirement
What we’re looking for:


	Someone creative but commercially aware – able to move beyond “posting content” and understand why we’re creating something, who it is for, what action we want, and whether it worked.


Salary
N200,000 monthly + performance incentives.

Click here to apply online

 

2.) Travel Sales & Business Development Executive

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview


	Help Akenn grow its client base and revenue by identifying opportunities, engaging prospective clients and developing relationships with corporate and high-value customers.
	This is a commercial, client-facing role for someone who can sell intelligently rather than simply respond to enquiries.


What you’ll do


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities across corporate and individual travel markets.
	Engage prospective clients, understand their needs and develop appropriate travel solutions.
	Follow up strategically on leads and convert qualified opportunities into paying clients.
	Build and nurture relationships with corporate accounts, HNIs and other high-value clients.
	Prepare persuasive proposals, presentations and commercial quotations.
	Develop opportunities for repeat business, referrals and account growth.
	Maintain an active and well-organised sales pipeline and accurate client records.
	Collaborate with the Travel Consultant and Operations functions to ensure a smooth transition from sale to service delivery.
	Track sales activity, conversion and revenue performance against agreed targets.
	Proactively identify partnerships, networking opportunities and channels that can generate new business for Akenn.


Requirement
What we’re looking for:


	Someone commercially minded, confident, articulate and persistent, who can open conversations, think strategically and actually close business.


Salary
N200,000 monthly + performance incentives.

Click here to apply online

 

3.) Travel Consultant, Visa & Operations Executive

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	Help clients turn travel ideas into well-planned, bookable journeys.
	You’ll consult with clients, design itineraries, prepare quotations, manage bookings and travel arrangements, and coordinate visa processes while delivering a high standard of service.


What you’ll do


	Consult with clients to understand their travel needs, preferences and budget, and recommend suitable travel solutions.
	Design tailored leisure and business itineraries and prepare accurate quotations and proposals.
	Coordinate flights, hotels, tours, transfers and other travel arrangements from booking through completion.
	Coordinate visa applications and related documentation, ensuring requirements are properly understood and processes are followed through.
	Communicate confidently with clients, suppliers and travel partners to keep each booking on track.
	Monitor bookings, resolve issues and proactively address changes or problems that may affect a client’s trip.
	Maintain accurate client, booking and visa records and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding requirements.
	Identify opportunities to improve the client’s travel experience and encourage repeat business and referrals.
	Work closely with the sales and marketing functions to ensure a smooth handover from enquiry to travel delivery.


What we’re looking for


	Someone who is smart, detail-oriented and client-focused, with practical travel and visa experience, strong problem-solving skills, good commercial awareness and the ability to take ownership of client journeys with minimal supervision.


Salary
N200,000 monthly + performance incentives.

Click here to apply online
